map.在浏览器端计算 MD5、SHA-1、SHA-256、SHA-512 哈希值。: Compute MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 hashes in your browser.
map.对输入计算固定长度的消息摘要（哈希），用于校验完整性。: Computes a fixed-length message digest (hash) of the input, for verifying integrity.
map.：MD5（128 bit）、SHA-1（160 bit）、SHA-256 / S: : MD5 (128 bit), SHA-1 (160 bit), SHA-256 and SHA-512 map an input of any length to a fixed-length digest.
map.：确定性（同输入必同输出）、雪崩效应（输入微改则输出大幅变化）、设计上抗碰撞。: : determinism (the same input always yields the same output), the avalanche effect (a tiny input change drastically alters the output) and resistance to collisions by design.
map.：MD5 与 SHA-1 已被实际攻破，禁止用于口令与签名；口令应加盐并用 bc: : MD5 and SHA-1 are practically broken, so never use them for passwords or signatures; passwords need salting and a slow hash such as bcrypt/scrypt/Argon2.
map.：非加密场景（文件校验和、去重）仍可使用，但需知晓碰撞风险。: : still fine for non-security uses (file checksums, deduplication), but be aware of the collision risk.
map.MD5：128 位哈希，已不推荐用于安全场景。: MD5: a 128-bit hash, no longer recommended for security.
map.SHA-1：160 位哈希，逐步被淘汰。: SHA-1: a 160-bit hash, being phased out.
map.SHA-256 / SHA-512：目前广泛使用的安全哈希算法。: SHA-256 / SHA-512: the secure hash algorithms in wide use today.
map.所有计算均在浏览器本地完成，文本不会上传。: Everything is computed locally in the browser; your text is never uploaded.
map.校验下载文件：把官方公布的 SHA-256 与自己算出的值比对，一致才说明文件完: Verifying a download: compare the officially published SHA-256 with the value you compute — only a match proves the file is complete and untampered; MD5, being broken, is only good for rough checks in non-security settings.
map.哈希能还原原文吗？: Can a hash be reversed to the original?
map.不能，哈希单向；且 MD5/SHA1 已不适合校验安全性，仅用于完整性。: No — hashing is one-way; and MD5/SHA-1 are no longer suitable for security checks, only for integrity.
map.安全场景不能用。MD5 已被证实可构造碰撞（两个不同文件得到同一摘要），不能用于: Not for security. MD5 is proven to allow constructed collisions (two different files producing the same digest), so it must not be used for signatures, passwords or tamper-proof checks; it remains usable in non-adversarial settings such as detecting transmission errors or building cache keys. New projects should standardize on SHA-256, and password storage must use a slow hash such as bcrypt/scrypt/Argon2.
